MIND. [1] [Æsc.]
Unable to fix his attention.
Depressed, low-spirited.
Feels dull, gloomy and despondent.
Extremely irritable ; loses temper easily, and gains control over it but slowly.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Æsc.]
Severe lancinating headache at base of brain, as if too full ; tympani ; tongue white.
Headache all over as if it would burst. θ Fever.
Dull pressure in forehead with slight nausea in stomach, followed at once by stitches in right hypochondrium.
Dull pain in occiput, with flushes of heat over occiput, neck and shoulders, and lame feeling in small of back. θ Prolapsus uteri.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Æsc.]
Can read well at a distance, can now read without spectacles.
Weight in eyes, they feel heavy and dull.
Sharp shooting in left eyeball, sometimes through left ear.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Æsc.]
Ringing in right ear.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Æsc.]
Dryness of posterior nares and throat, with sneezing, followed by severe coryza.
Stinging and burning in posterior nares and soft palate.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Æsc.]
Pale, miserable appearance.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Æsc.]
Tongue furred. θ Hemorrhoids.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Æsc.]
Pricking, formication, burning and stinging in fauces ; shooting in left side.
Violent burning in throat, with raw feeling.
Feeling of dryness and roughness of throat as from taking cold.
Frequent inclination to swallow, with dry constricted fauces, burning.
Throat and œsophagus constricted, scraped, causes hawking.
Dark congested state of fauces, with a full feeling and irritation. θ Chronic angina.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Æsc.]
Loss of appetite. θ Hemorrhoids.
Considerable thirst.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Æsc.]
Eructations : sour ; greasy ; bitter ; frequent ; empty ; taste of food, with nausea.
Nausea. θ Hemorrhoids.
Nausea most after eating or in afternoon.
Desire to vomit.
Violent retching and vomiting, with burning in stomach.
Heartburn and gulping up all food after eating ; can hardly eat anything.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Æsc.]
Pressure as from a stone in pit of stomach.
At the epigastrium : fulness ; burning distress, aching ; pressure as from a stone ; flying pains after headache.
Constant distress and burning in stomach, inclination to vomit.
Violent burning in stomach, bowels and liver, with distress, nausea and violent vomiting.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Æsc.]
Constant, severe aching, from pit of stomach to lower lobe of liver.
Tenderness in right hypochondriac region ; full feeling.
Constant dull aching distress in right lower lobe of liver and region of gall bladder ; much distress in liver and epigastrium.
Constant aching pain from pit of stomach to right lobe of liver.
Congestion of liver and portal system.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Æsc.]
Abdomen tender to touch.
Flatulent pains in bowels. θ Hemorrhoids.
Sensation of fulness in abdomen. θ Hemorrhoids.
Throbbing in abdomen. θ Portal congestion.
Hemorrhoidal colic.
Throbbing in pelvic cavity and hypogastrium. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Pain in hypogastric region. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Inguinal hernia.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Æsc.]
Rectum : feels full ; dryness and itching. θ Hemorrhoids.
Rectum feels as if full of small sticks.
Rectum sore, with burning and itching.
Considerable pain, aching, swelling and rigid hardness of rectum, commencing an hour after stool, continuing from two to six hours. θ Hemorrhoids.
Urging to stool, often ineffectual ; rectum seems swollen.
Light-colored soft stool. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Chronic diarrhœa.
First part hard, black, last of about natural consistency, but white as milk, followed by tearing in anus. θ Liver complaint.
Very dark stools. θ Hemorrhoids.
Stool large, hard, dry, knotted, voided with difficulty and followed by severe cutting, burning or constricting pains in anus, a portion of which seems to protrude ; with dull pains in lower abdomen and severe lumbo sacral backache.
Sense of fulness and bearing down with constipation. θ Hemorrhoids.
Bowels always wanted to be relieved. θ Hemorrhoids.
Constipation. θ Hemorrhoids.
Hard dry stool passed with difficulty, with dryness of rectum and heat ; no bleeding.
After stool, pain in anus intense, lasting till evening ; every other day stool, inclined to bleeding. θ Hemorrhoids.
Stool followed by rectal fulness. θ Hemorrhoids.
Much pain after stool in morning, not subsiding till evening.
Intolerable burning, itching, stinging pain at anus, with feeling of fulness, which could only be relieved by rubbing or by pressure ; only felt while walking.
Anus feels raw.
Pain like a knife sawing backward and forward through anus. θ Hemorrhoids.
Anus sore, it protrudes at or after stool.
Prolapsus ani after stool, with dull backache.
Fulness and itching in anus after a walk.
Pain in anus commences about an hour after evacuation, and continues from two to six hours. θ Hemorrhoids.
Occasional attacks of hemorrhoids, attended with very little hemorrhage, although considerable pain, aching, swelling and rigid hardness of rectum ; attacks usually accompany constipation.
Hemorrhoids, blind and painful, rarely bleeding.
Blind piles of ten years' standing ; bleeding of twenty years.
Several large piles which seem to block up rectum, little or no bleeding, great suffering, constipation.
Large protruding painful hemorrhoids. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Appearance of hemorrhoids, like ground-nuts, of a purple color, very painful, and with a sensation of burning.
Hemorrhoids painful, burning, purplish ; generally "blind ;" aching and lameness, or sharp, shooting pains up back.
Hemorrhoids, could not sit or lie down with ease.
Pain in hemorrhoids, like a knife sawing up and down, could not sit, stand or lie, only possible position was kneeling ; slight protrusion.
Some carry nuts in their breeches-pockets as a preventive.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Æsc.]
Desires to urinate often, but passes little at a time, scanty and dark yellow, with scalding in passing through urethra.
Urine : dark, muddy, passed with much pain ; scalding ; with dark-brown sediment ; yellow, with thick-white mucous sediment ; hot.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Æsc.]
Seminal emissions. θ Disease of prostate.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Æsc.]
Inflamed cervix uteri attended with retroversion, prolapsus, ulceration, enlargement and induration, when characterized by great tenderness, heat and throbbing.
Uterine soreness, with throbbing in hypogastrium. θ Hemorrhoids.
Old cases of leucorrhœa ; discharge of a dark, yellow color, thick and sticky ; < after a menstrual period, increased by walking, corrodes labia, aching in sacrum and knees.
Leucorrhœa, with lameness in back, across sacro-iliac articulations, and great fatigue from walking, because that part of back gives out in walking even but a little way.
Thick, dark and corroding leucorrhœa, with constant backache. θ Prolapsus uteri.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Æsc.]
During pregnancy, sacro-iliac symphysis gives out while she walks ; she must sit down ; feels best lying.
Piles troublesome during pregnancy.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Æsc.]
Hoarse voice.
Catarrhal laryngitis, laryngeal cough, and perhaps coughs dependent on hepatic disorders.
   

COUGH. [27] [Æsc.]
Dry short cough, increased by swallowing and deep breathing.
Chronic cough, with emaciation.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Æsc.]
Soreness over lungs on taking a deep breath. θ Rush of blood.
Pituitous consumption.
Chest-complaints of horses.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Æsc.]
Disturbances of heart, with hemorrhoidal complaints.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Æsc.]
Weakness, lameness and weariness in back of neck.
Spine feels weak.
Great lameness of back, < on walking. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Constant dull backache ; walking almost impossible ; scarcely able to rise or stoop or to rise after sitting.
Weakness, weariness and lameness in small of back.
Constant backache affecting sacrum and hips, much < by walking or stooping forward.
Tearing in small of back and hips when walking.
Severe pain across back and hips, as if they would break in two. θ Hemorrhoids.
Pain, especially in hip and sacrum. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Backache in cervical, lumbar and sacral region, or sacro-iliac symphysis, < from motion.
Constant dull pain across hips and sacrum.
Dull aching in small of back, < from motion.
Pain and lameness in each sacro-iliac symphysis, < when walking ; patient can hardly walk on account of this lameness in back, which seems to be of a rheumatic character. θ Leucorrhœa. θ Constipation. θ Hemorrhoids. θ Rheumatism.
Pain across sacro-iliac symphysis, more or less constant, with a feeling as if back would give way at that point, causing great fatigue when walking. θ Uterine complaints.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Æsc.]
Rheumatic pain in right scapula and right side of chest ; < when inhaling.
Cracking of skin on hands.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Æsc.]
Left knee swollen, painful and stiff ; unable to bear slightest pressure.
Legs so weak she can hardly walk ; spine weak. See 31.
Back and legs weak : can hardly walk, must lie down.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Æsc.]
Could not sit nor lie down with ease ; bleeding of piles gives some relief. θ Hemorrhoids.
Dreadful pain, could not sit, stand or lie ; only possible motion was kneeling. θ Hemorrhoids.
Motion : muscles feel sore ; backache < ; soreness >.
   

NERVES. [36] [Æsc.]
Cannot walk, feels so weak. θ Headache with drowsiness.
Very much weakened. θ Hemorrhoids.
Paralytic feeling in arms, legs and spine.
A kind of tetanus after a horrible constriction in pit of stomach, she got stiff with the pain, hands blue with a pricking and stinging, lasting two hours ; second attack of same kind.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Æsc.]
Restless all night ; thoughts continually crowding on mind prevent sleep.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Æsc.]
Worse in Winter and better in Summer. θ Hemorrhoids.
   

FEVER. [40] [Æsc.]
Intermittent fevers.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Æsc.]
Sensation like hot lightning.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Æsc.]
Fulness in various parts, as if they contained an undue amount of blood.
Mucous membranes dry, swollen ; burn and feel raw.
Glandular swellings of bone.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Æsc.]
Bilious temperament. θ Anal troubles.
Climacteric years. θ Piles.
